must_contain: An ABHA address looks like an email address, for example ajeet123@abdm on production or something@sbx on the sandbox.
It is the handle a person shares at a facility, and the identifier that care contexts are linked against.
The part after the @ is the domain of the HIE-CM holding the address, and that is where the value for the X-CM-ID header comes from.
notes: Group B, a bare topic noun phrase: it catches a definition that confuses the address with the ABHA number or omits that the suffix names the HIE-CM.
